author: dev.patel
summary: cart 2.4.0: memoize promo eligibility per session
diff:
--- a/internal/promo/eligibility.go
+++ b/internal/promo/eligibility.go
@@ -9,8 +9,17 @@
+var eligibilityCache = map[string][]Promo{} // keyed by session id
+var cacheMu sync.Mutex
+
 func Eligible(ctx context.Context, sess Session) []Promo {
+	cacheMu.Lock()
+	defer cacheMu.Unlock()
+	if p, ok := eligibilityCache[sess.ID]; ok {
+		return p
+	}
 	p := computeEligible(ctx, sess)
+	eligibilityCache[sess.ID] = p
 	return p
